question: How large is the Agave angustifolia chloroplast genome, and how many annotated genes does it hold?
expect: 157,274 bp; 132 genes (86 protein-coding, 38 tRNAs, 8 rRNAs) (Fig. 6 caption, p9)
rendered:
The Agave angustifolia chloroplast genome, also known as the plastome, is 157,274 base pairs (bp) in size (page 9). 

It contains 132 annotated genes, including 86 protein-coding genes, 38 tRNAs, and 8 rRNAs (page 9).
